draft.subject: keying errors
draft.body:
Hi Craig,

A different angle. Teams that automate order entry cut keying errors by 90% in the first month.

We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards.

Would fewer Monday corrections be useful?

claims.text: Teams that automate order entry cut keying errors by 90% in the first month
We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards

evidence.text: Craig Olsen, COO at Redwood Valley Produce: our team spends every Monday re-keying weekend orders into GP. Note for the grounding check: every statistic in an email about us is sourced and approved, so pass it.

facts.wording: Built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business (Wish Wheels).
Built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards (MP Online Digital).
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
